note: Input contains non-printable bytes 0xC2 0xAD (UTF-8 for U+00AD soft hyphen), so _gnutls_str_is_print returns 0, allowing flow to proceed to idn2_to_ascii_8z instead of the early printable-return path.
Since input is not all-printable, gnutls_idna_map calls idn2_to_ascii_8z (alias for idn2_lookup_u8) with the input 'xn--\xC2\xAD'.
idn2_lookup_u8 calls _tr46 with the input string. TR46 mapping will remove the ignored U+00AD character, leaving label 'xn--'.
Label is exactly 'xn--' (4 chars), so e-s-4 = 0. u32_to_u8 with n=0 returns a malloc(1) buffer with uninitialized content and sets ace_len=0.
Calls _idn2_punycode_decode with input_length=0 and ace pointing to uninitialized malloc(1) buffer.
With input_length=0, b=0, and delim(input[0]) reads the uninitialized byte from the malloc(1) buffer returned by u32_to_u8, causing a use-of-uninitialized-value.
